exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.summary: The cornerstone lower-body lift: strong legs, a braced trunk and a tall spine.
instructions: Set the bar just below shoulder height and step under it, bar resting on your upper back.
Unrack, take a shoulder-width stance with toes slightly out and brace your trunk.
Sit down and back until your hips pass knee height, then drive through mid-foot to stand.
exercises.breathing: Inhale at the top, brace, exhale through the hardest third of the ascent.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.summary: The classic horizontal push for chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Retract your shoulder blades, unrack and lower the bar to mid-chest.
Press up and slightly back until your elbows lock without losing the shoulder set.
exercises.breathing: Inhale on the descent, exhale through the press.

exercises.name: Bicep curl
exercises.summary: Direct biceps work with a strict, slow eccentric.
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides and palms forward.
Curl without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower over three seconds until your arms are straight.
exercises.breathing: Exhale on the curl, inhale down.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.summary: A demanding rear-foot-elevated squat for glutes, quads and honest single-leg work.
instructions: Rest the top of your rear foot on a bench, front foot a stride ahead.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive through the front foot to stand, keeping the hips square.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.summary: A postural pull for rear delts and upper-back health.
instructions: Set the cable at face height and hold the rope with palms facing in.
Pull toward your forehead, separating the rope ends.
Squeeze behind your shoulders, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.summary: A front-loaded squat that teaches depth and an upright torso with one dumbbell.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at chest height, elbows tucked under it.
Stand slightly wider than hips and lower between your knees, keeping your chest proud.
Pause at the bottom, then push the floor away and stand tall.
cues: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom
Spread the floor with your feet
exercises.breathing: Inhale down, exhale as you stand.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.summary: Short-range, high-tension glute work that carries over to sprinting and squats.
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the bar across your hips.
Plant your feet so shins are vertical at the top, then drive your hips up.
Squeeze glutes hard at the top, ribs down, and lower under control.
cues: Pause one second at the top
exercises.breathing: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you lock out.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.summary: Explosive hip extension that trains power and conditioning together.
instructions: Hinge and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward so the bell floats to chest height.
Let it fall back into the hinge and repeat without rushing.
exercises.breathing: Sharp exhale at the top of each swing.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.summary: A scalable vertical pull for lats and biceps when pull-ups are not yet there.
instructions: Sit tall with thighs secured and grip the bar a little wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest while keeping your torso nearly upright.
Control the bar back overhead until your arms are long.
cues: Don’t lean back to cheat the range
exercises.breathing: Exhale as you pull, inhale on the return.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.summary: Side-delt isolation for shoulder width and healthy pressing mechanics.
instructions: Stand with a slight bend in your elbows and dumbbells by your sides.
Raise the weights out and up until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly, resisting the drop.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.summary: A standing press that builds shoulders and demands full-body bracing.
instructions: Stand with the bar at collarbone height, grip just outside your shoulders.
Brace your trunk and press the bar overhead, moving your head back and then through.
Lower under control to the upper chest.
cues: Bar path close to your face
Finish with biceps by your ears
exercises.breathing: Inhale before the press, exhale at lockout.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.summary: A hip hinge that builds hamstrings and teaches you to load your posterior chain.
instructions: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs, feet hip-width.
Push your hips back with a soft knee bend, sliding the bar down your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings tell you to, then squeeze your glutes to return.
exercises.breathing: Inhale at the top, hold the brace through the descent, exhale on the way up.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.summary: A supported pull that builds lats and teaches shoulder-blade control.
instructions: Place one hand and knee on a bench, back flat and the dumbbell hanging.
Pull the weight toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Pause when the shoulder blade is squeezed, then lower slowly.
cues: Elbow to hip, not to shoulder
exercises.breathing: Exhale on the pull, inhale on the lower.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.summary: Build resilient calves and ankle capacity with a full stretch and pause.
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and heels hanging.
Drop your heels for a deep stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible and pause.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.summary: A joint-friendly triceps isolation with constant cable tension.
instructions: Stand facing the cable with elbows tucked to your ribs.
Push the handle down until your elbows are straight.
Let the handle rise until your forearms pass parallel, keeping elbows still.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.summary: Single-leg strength and control with a built-in balance challenge.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step forward into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Drive through the front foot and step through into the next lunge.
cues: Front knee tracks over the foot
exercises.breathing: Inhale on the step, exhale as you drive up.

exercises.name: Bridge pose
exercises.summary: An active backbend that strengthens glutes and opens the chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet hip-width.
Press into your feet and lift your hips, keeping ribs from flaring.
Roll your shoulders under and hold, then lower one vertebra at a time.
exercises.breathing: Steady breaths into the rib cage.

exercises.name: Cat–cow
exercises.summary: A breath-led spinal wave that restores segmental movement.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a long spine.
Inhale, drop your belly and lift your chest and tailbone.
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin.
cues: Spread movement through the whole spine
exercises.breathing: Inhale to extend, exhale to flex.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.summary: A resting fold that decompresses the spine and quiets the mind.
instructions: Kneel with big toes together and knees apart.
Fold forward, reaching your arms out and resting your forehead down.
Let your breath move into your back body.

exercises.name: Cobra pose
exercises.summary: A gentle backbend that opens the front body and builds spinal extension.
instructions: Lie face down with hands under shoulders and elbows close.
Press lightly into your hands and lift your chest without collapsing your neck.
Roll your shoulders back and lengthen your tailbone toward your heels.
exercises.breathing: Inhale to lift, breathe into the ribs.

exercises.name: Downward-facing dog
exercises.summary: A full-body shape that lengthens hamstrings and wakes up the shoulders.
instructions: From hands and knees, lift your hips up and back into an inverted V.
Spread your fingers, press the floor away and soften your knees.
Let your head hang and lengthen your spine with each breath.
exercises.breathing: Long, even breaths through the nose.

exercises.name: Legs up the wall
exercises.summary: A restorative inversion to help the nervous system and legs settle.
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, then swing your legs up as you lie back.
Get your hips close to the wall and let your arms rest open.
Stay for several minutes, breathing slowly.
cues: Cover your eyes if you like

exercises.name: Pigeon pose
exercises.summary: A deep hip opener that targets glutes and external hip rotation.
instructions: From all fours, bring one knee forward and your shin across the mat.
Extend the back leg behind you and square your hips as much as feels kind.
Fold forward over the front leg or stay upright, breathing into the hip.

exercises.name: Seated twist
exercises.summary: A grounded rotation that restores thoracic mobility after sitting.
instructions: Sit tall with legs crossed or extended, spine long.
Place one hand behind you and the other on the opposite knee.
Inhale to grow tall, exhale to rotate a little further.
exercises.breathing: Inhale to lengthen, exhale to twist.

exercises.name: Tree pose
exercises.summary: A classic one-legged balance that trains ankle stability and attention.
instructions: Stand tall and root your standing foot into the mat.
Place the other foot on your calf or inner thigh, never on the knee.
Bring hands to your heart and find a soft focal point.

exercises.name: Warrior II
exercises.summary: A grounded standing pose for leg strength, hip opening and steady focus.
instructions: Step your feet wide, turn the front foot out and bend the front knee over it.
Reach the arms out to the sides and stack shoulders over hips.
Gaze over the front hand and stay rooted through both feet.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip rotation
exercises.summary: Controlled internal and external hip rotation, seated and unloaded.
instructions: Sit with both knees bent to 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Keep your chest tall and lift both knees to rotate to the other side.
Move slowly and use your hands for support if needed.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.summary: A deep hip-flexor and quad stretch for people who sit a lot.
instructions: Kneel with one knee against a wall or couch, shin vertical.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the back glute.
Stay tall or bring the same-side arm overhead for more length.
exercises.breathing: Slow breaths; back off if the knee complains.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.summary: A resting squat that keeps hips, knees and ankles in their full range.
instructions: Stand with feet a little wider than shoulders.
Sit down into your deepest comfortable squat and hold your heels down.
Use a support under your heels or hold a doorframe if needed.
exercises.breathing: Slow breaths; let tension melt on each exhale.

exercises.name: Neck release
exercises.summary: A seated release for the neck and upper traps after screen time.
instructions: Sit tall and let one ear fall toward the shoulder.
Rest the same-side hand lightly on your head for a gentle stretch.
Breathe, return, and switch sides.

exercises.name: Open-book thoracic rotation
exercises.summary: A side-lying drill to reclaim upper-back rotation without arching the low back.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees stacked and bent in front of you.
Reach the top arm across and open your chest toward the ceiling.
Follow your hand with your eyes and return slowly.
exercises.breathing: Inhale to prepare, exhale to open.

exercises.name: Shoulder dislocates
exercises.summary: A gentle pass-through drill that restores shoulder flexion and extension.
instructions: Hold a stick or band wide with both hands in front of your hips.
Keep your arms long and circle them overhead and behind you.
Use a wider grip if your shoulders feel pinched.
exercises.breathing: Inhale as the arms go overhead.

exercises.name: Standing hamstring stretch
exercises.summary: A simple, controllable hamstring lengthener with a supported spine.
instructions: Place one heel on a low step with the leg straight.
Hinge from the hip with a long spine until you feel the hamstring.
Breathe and hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Wall calf stretch
exercises.summary: Ankle dorsiflexion you can feel, essential for deep squats and hiking.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and heel down.
Bend the front knee and lean toward the wall, keeping the back leg straight.
Hold, then bend the back knee slightly for the deeper calf.

exercises.name: Wall slide
exercises.summary: A shoulder-mobility drill that teaches overhead reach with a rib cage that stays stacked.
instructions: Stand with your back to a wall, forearms and head touching it.
Slide your arms up while keeping ribs down and elbows on the wall.
Return slowly to the starting position.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.summary: One flowing sequence that opens hips, hamstrings and thoracic spine.
instructions: Step into a deep lunge with both hands inside the front foot.
Drop the back knee if needed and press the front knee out.
Reach the inside arm up and rotate your chest open, then switch sides.
exercises.breathing: Inhale to reach, exhale to settle deeper.

exercises.name: Wrist prep
exercises.summary: A quick wrist and forearm sequence before any floor-based training.
instructions: From all fours, turn your fingers toward your knees and rock gently.
Flip to the backs of your hands and rock again with care.
Finish with slow wrist circles in both directions.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.summary: A full-body, no-equipment conditioner with a squat, push and jump.
instructions: From standing, crouch and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step back to a plank, complete a push-up if you like, then jump the feet in.
Stand and finish with a small jump, landing softly.
exercises.breathing: Exhale on the jump, inhale on the descent.

exercises.name: Forearm plank
exercises.summary: A foundational anti-extension hold for the whole trunk.
instructions: Set elbows under shoulders and forearms on the floor.
Extend your legs and tuck your pelvis so your body forms a line.
Spread your shoulder blades and hold while breathing evenly.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.summary: A gentle but effective glute activator and hip-extension drill.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, heels near your glutes.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Pause and squeeze, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.summary: A demanding lower-ab exercise that also builds grip and shoulder stability.
instructions: Hang from the bar with shoulders active and legs together.
Curl your pelvis and lift your legs until they pass parallel.
Lower slowly without swinging.
cues: Curl the pelvis, don’t just lift legs
exercises.breathing: Exhale as you lift, inhale down.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.summary: A full-body anterior-chain isometric that teaches real core control.
instructions: Lie on your back, press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift shoulder blades and legs, reaching arms overhead.
Hold the banana shape while breathing behind the brace.
exercises.breathing: Slow nasal breaths without losing the brace.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.summary: A scalable horizontal pull using a bar, rings or a sturdy table.
instructions: Lie under a low bar and grip it slightly wider than shoulders.
Keep your body in a line and pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower until your arms are fully straight.
cues: Raise the bar to make it easier

exercises.name: Mountain climber
exercises.summary: A fast, core-driven conditioning move from a plank position.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch sides quickly.
Keep hips low and shoulders stacked over hands.

exercises.name: Parallel bar dip
exercises.summary: A heavy bodyweight press for triceps and lower chest.
instructions: Support yourself on the bars with arms locked.
Lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up, keeping shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.summary: A bodyweight overhead press that builds shoulders and upper-chest strength.
instructions: Start in a downward-dog shape with hips high and hands shoulder-width.
Bend your elbows to lower the crown of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.summary: The benchmark vertical pull for lats, biceps and shoulder health.
instructions: Hang with an overhand grip just outside shoulder width.
Set your shoulders down and pull your elbows toward your ribs.
Bring your chin over the bar, then lower all the way to a long hang.
exercises.breathing: Exhale as you pull, inhale on the descent.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.summary: The foundational horizontal push — scalable from knees to feet-elevated.
instructions: Set hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in one long line.
Lower your chest until it is a fist above the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press the floor away and lock out without letting the hips sag.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.summary: Lateral core strength and hip stability on one arm.
instructions: Lie on one side with elbow under shoulder and feet stacked.
Lift your hips so your body is a straight line from head to feet.
Reach the top arm to the ceiling and hold.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.summary: A fast, low-space cardio burst that wakes up the hips and calves.
instructions: Stand tall and drive one knee at a time toward hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep a quick cadence.
Pump your arms and land softly.

exercises.name: Incline walk
exercises.summary: Low-impact aerobic work that is kind to joints and easy to recover from.
instructions: Set a treadmill incline of 8–12% or find a steady hill.
Walk at a pace that raises your heart rate but lets you speak.
Keep your posture tall and let your arms swing naturally.

exercises.name: Jump rope
exercises.summary: A compact, high-return conditioning tool for calves and coordination.
instructions: Hold the handles at hip height with elbows close to your ribs.
Turn the rope with your wrists and jump just high enough to clear it.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.summary: A simple full-body warm-up that raises heart rate in seconds.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet wide while sweeping your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Shadow boxing
exercises.summary: Playful, low-impact intervals that train the cardiovascular system and coordination.
instructions: Set a light stance with one foot forward and hands up.
Throw controlled jabs and crosses, rotating through the hips.
Stay light on your feet and breathe out on every punch.

exercises.name: Zone 2 run
exercises.summary: Conversational-pace running that builds your aerobic engine without burning you out.
instructions: Warm up with five minutes of easy walking or jogging.
Run at a pace where you can hold a conversation in full sentences.
Cool down with five minutes of walking and breathe through your nose.

exercises.name: Body scan
exercises.summary: A guided-feel meditation that moves attention through the body and releases holding.
instructions: Lie down with palms up and let your feet fall open.
Move your attention slowly from your toes to the top of your head.
When you find tension, breathe into it and let it soften on the exhale.

exercises.name: Box breathing
exercises.summary: Four equal counts in, hold, out and hold — a portable reset for the nervous system.
instructions: Sit or lie comfortably and exhale fully.
Inhale for four, hold for four, exhale for four, hold for four.
Repeat for several minutes, letting your shoulders drop.

exercises.name: Physiological sigh
exercises.summary: Two inhales and a long exhale — the fastest known voluntary calm-down.
instructions: Inhale through your nose until about 80% full.
Add a short second inhale through the nose.
Exhale slowly and completely through the mouth, then repeat.
cues: Make the exhale longer than the inhale

exercises.name: Progressive muscle relaxation
exercises.summary: Tense and release each muscle group to teach your body the difference.
instructions: Lie down and take a few slow breaths.
Tense one muscle group for five seconds, then release for ten.
Work from your feet up to your face, noticing the contrast.
exercises.breathing: Inhale to tense, exhale to release.

exercises.name: Supine twist
exercises.summary: A gentle reclined rotation that lets the spine and hips unwind.
instructions: Lie on your back and draw your knees toward your chest.
Let both knees fall to one side while your shoulders stay down.
Breathe and hold, then switch sides.
